reason: The cited evidence (E1) demonstrates that coherent nanoprecipitates can enhance strength and ductility in a W-based HEA, but it does not study the WTaTiVZr alloy, nor does it provide data on toughness or confirm that the same precipitates form in this specific system. premises: Coherent nanoprecipitates can form in W-based high-entropy alloys and facilitate dislocation transmission.
Such nanoprecipitates relieve stress concentrations that would otherwise cause premature crack initiation.
The WTaTiVZr alloy will form coherent nanoprecipitates under the specified conditions.
The presence of these nanoprecipitates will lead to higher ductility and toughness compared to pure tungsten.
The mechanism observed in other W-based HEAs translates to the WTaTiVZr system.
